children: Warren Buffett is stepping down as the chairman of Berkshire Hathaway effective immediately, the company announced Friday.
His son, Howard Buffett, will replace him as chairman. Warren Buffett will now serve as chairman emeritus of the company and remain a member of the board.
This is breaking news. Check back for more analysis soon.
